series.title: US chip and electronic-component production
series.about: How much US factories produced of semiconductors and other electronic components, as an index (2017 = 100).
series.source: Federal Reserve, Industrial Production report (G.17), via FRED

series.title: US chip factory capacity in use
series.about: Share of US semiconductor and electronic-component factory capacity that is being used.
series.source: Federal Reserve, Industrial Production report (G.17), via FRED

series.title: US chip producer prices
series.about: Prices US semiconductor makers receive for their products (Producer Price Index). It is adjusted for quality gains, so it tends to drift down over time.
series.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, via FRED

series.title: US electronics new orders
series.about: Dollar value of new orders received by US makers of computers and electronic products, seasonally adjusted.
series.source: US Census Bureau, factory orders survey (M3), via FRED

series.title: US electronics shipments
series.about: Dollar value of computers and electronic products shipped by US makers, seasonally adjusted.
series.source: US Census Bureau, factory orders survey (M3), via FRED

series.title: US electronics inventories
series.about: Dollar value of inventories held by US makers of computers and electronic products, seasonally adjusted.
series.source: US Census Bureau, factory orders survey (M3), via FRED

series.title: US computer shipments
series.about: Dollar value of computers and related products shipped by US makers, seasonally adjusted.
series.source: US Census Bureau, factory orders survey (M3), via FRED

firms.trade:tw_rel:electronic_components: TSMC, UMC, Vanguard (contract chipmaking); MediaTek, Novatek, Realtek (chips they design, made by TSMC); ASE, KYEC (packaging and testing); Nanya, Winbond, Macronix (memory).
firms.trade:tw_rel:ict_av: Foxconn (Hon Hai), Quanta, Wistron, Wiwynn, Inventec (AI and cloud servers for NVIDIA, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta); Gigabyte, ASUS, MSI (servers, boards); Accton (network switches).
firms.trade:tw_rel:to_us: Mostly AI servers (Foxconn, Quanta, Wistron, Wiwynn) and chips (TSMC) for US customers such as NVIDIA, AMD, Apple and the cloud companies.
firms.trade:tw_rel:to_china_hk: Mostly chips (TSMC, MediaTek, ASE, memory makers) going into phones, PCs and electronics assembled in China.
firms.trade:tw_rel:total: About three-quarters is electronics and ICT products from the firms above.
firms.trade:tw_ord:electronics: Orders taken by TSMC, UMC (chipmaking), MediaTek, Novatek, Realtek (chip design), ASE (packaging), Nanya, Winbond (memory).
firms.trade:tw_ord:ict: Orders taken by Foxconn, Quanta, Wistron, Wiwynn, Inventec (AI servers), Gigabyte, ASUS (servers, PCs), Accton (switches).
firms.trade:tw_ord:optoelectronics: Orders taken by AUO, Innolux (displays), Largan, Genius (camera lenses).
firms.trade:tw_ord:machinery: Orders taken by Taiwanese machine makers, including chip-equipment suppliers such as Hiwin and Gudeng.
firms.trade:tw_ord:to_us: Mostly AI servers and chips ordered by US customers (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta).
firms.trade:tw_ord:to_china_hk: Mostly chips and components ordered for electronics assembled in China.
firms.trade:tw_ord:to_europe: Mixed: chips, servers and industrial goods.
firms.trade:tw_ord:total: About 78% comes from electronics and ICT orders.
firms.trade:kr_rel:semiconductors: Samsung Electronics (DRAM, NAND, HBM, foundry) and SK Hynix (DRAM, HBM, NAND) make nearly all of it; DB HiTek is a small foundry.
firms.trade:kr_rel:computers: Mostly SSDs from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (including its Solidigm unit).
firms.trade:kr_rel:to_china: Mostly memory chips (Samsung, SK Hynix) for Chinese phone and PC makers and their own Chinese plants, plus chemicals and displays.
firms.trade:kr_rel:to_us: Cars (Hyundai, Kia), chips and SSDs (Samsung, SK Hynix), and batteries (LG Energy Solution, Samsung SDI, SK On).
firms.trade:kr_rel:total: Semiconductors are now about half of the total.
firms.trade:kr_pre:semiconductors: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix (DRAM, HBM, NAND).
firms.trade:kr_pre:computer_peripherals: Mostly SSDs from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
firms.trade:kr_pre:wireless: Samsung Electronics (Galaxy phones and parts) and LG Innotek (camera modules).
firms.trade:kr_pre:to_us: Cars (Hyundai, Kia), chips (Samsung, SK Hynix), batteries.
firms.trade:kr_pre:to_vietnam: Chips and parts for Samsung's Vietnamese phone plants.
firms.trade:kr_pre:total: Semiconductors are about half of the total.
firms.trade:us_x:8542: Intel, Micron, Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, GlobalFoundries, onsemi (chips made in US fabs).
firms.trade:us_x:8486: Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA, Onto Innovation (chipmaking equipment).
firms.trade:us_m_tw:8471: AI and cloud servers built in Taiwan by Foxconn, Quanta, Wistron, Wiwynn, Inventec for NVIDIA, Dell, HPE, Supermicro and the cloud companies.
firms.trade:us_m_tw:8473: GPU baseboards and server modules (Wistron, Foxconn), motherboards (Gigabyte, ASUS).
firms.trade:us_m_tw:8542: Chips made by TSMC and packaged by ASE, for NVIDIA, AMD, Apple, Qualcomm and others.
firms.trade:jp_x:8486: Tokyo Electron, Screen, Kokusai Electric (wafer processing); Advantest (testing); Disco (cutting and grinding); Lasertec (inspection); Canon, Nikon (lithography).
firms.trade:jp_x:8542: Kioxia (memory), Renesas, Sony (image sensors), Rohm, Toshiba (power chips).
firms.trade:jp_x:854232: Kioxia (NAND flash) and Micron's Hiroshima plant (DRAM, HBM).
firms.fred:IPG3344S: US chip and component plants of Intel, Micron, Texas Instruments, GlobalFoundries, Analog Devices, onsemi, plus Samsung's Austin and TSMC's Arizona fabs.
firms.fred:CAPUTLG3344S: The same US plants: Intel, Micron, Texas Instruments, GlobalFoundries, Analog Devices, onsemi, plus Samsung's Austin and TSMC's Arizona fabs.
firms.fred:PCU334413334413: Prices charged by US chipmakers such as Intel, Micron, Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, GlobalFoundries and onsemi.
firms.fred:A34SNO: US factories making chips (Intel, Micron, Texas Instruments), servers (Supermicro, Dell, HPE), networking gear (Cisco, Arista's contract builders) and defense electronics.
firms.fred:A34SVS: Same makers as orders: US chip, server, networking and defense-electronics factories.

firms.trade:tw_ord:electronics_to_china_hk: Chips from TSMC, MediaTek, Novatek, ASE and memory makers for Chinese phone, PC and electronics makers.
